sentences.en: On January 3rd, 2000, the Weather Channel debuted a new show called Your Weather Today.
sentences.zh: 2000年1月3日，天气频道推出了一档名为《您今天的天气》的新节目。

sentences.zh: 达拉斯，你们又迎来了一个没有降雨的破纪录日子。

sentences.en: It was a show about weather.
sentences.zh: 这是一档关于天气的节目。

sentences.en: We have the forecast for you, plus an update on conditions in your town in this edition of Your Weather Today.
sentences.zh: 在本期《您今天的天气》中，我们为您提供天气预报，以及您所在城镇的天气状况更新。

sentences.en: It was, we think, the very first new television show of the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这可能是21世纪的第一档新电视节目。

sentences.en: In the 26 years that followed, we got a lot more new shows.
sentences.zh: 在随后的26年里，我们有了更多的新节目。

sentences.en: More, your old house coming back.
sentences.zh: 莫伊拉，你那栋老房子回来了。

sentences.zh: 我正在拍摄电视里的莫伊拉·罗斯。

sentences.en: Some of them better than your weather today.
sentences.zh: 其中一些比《您今天的天气》更好。

sentences.zh: 先生们，发动你们的引擎，愿最优秀的女性获胜。

sentences.zh: 把我的保险箱再放进珍妮里。

sentences.zh: 眼神清澈，内心充实。

sentences.zh: 动不了！

sentences.zh: 我们走！

sentences.zh: 所以，把它放在你的烟斗里抽掉吧。

sentences.en: Here in 2026, TV is now firmly a prestige art form with big stars, auteur creators, and huge production budgets.
sentences.zh: 到了2026年的今天，电视已稳固地成为一种精品艺术形式，拥有大牌明星、作者型创作者和巨额制作预算。

sentences.en: And it's become absolutely central to the cultural conversation.
sentences.zh: 它已成为文化对话的核心。

sentences.en: So to commemorate that evolution of TV over the last quarter century, my colleagues here at the Times undertook a little project.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念过去四分之一个世纪电视的发展，我在《时报》的同事们开展了一个小项目。

sentences.en: They contacted over 1,000 TV luminaries, showrunners, writers, actors, and asked them to pick their favorite TV shows of the last 26 years.
sentences.zh: 他们联系了1000多位电视界名流、剧集主管、编剧和演员，请他们选出过去26年里他们最喜欢的电视节目。

sentences.en: And they heard back from a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 他们收到了很多人的回复。

sentences.en: People like Lena Waithe.
sentences.zh: 像莉娜·韦斯这样的人。

sentences.en: Bojack Horseman is like this crazy experiment that should have gone awry.
sentences.zh: 《马男波杰克》就像是一个本该出错的疯狂实验。

sentences.en: Adam Scott.
sentences.zh: 亚当·斯科特。

sentences.en: The good wife is that legal procedural, but it cuts way deeper.
sentences.zh: 《傲骨贤妻》是一部法律程序剧，但它挖掘得更深。

sentences.en: And Mad Men creator Matthew Weiner.
sentences.zh: 还有《广告狂人》的创作者马修·韦纳。

sentences.en: I loved Orange is the New Black the minute I saw it.
sentences.zh: 我从看到《女子监狱》的第一眼起就爱上了它。

sentences.en: Then they took all that data and compiled a list of the 100 best TV shows of the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 然后他们整理了所有数据，汇编了一份21世纪100部最佳电视节目榜单。

sentences.en: A list we've been slowly rolling out over the course of this week.
sentences.zh: 这份榜单我们已经在这一周里陆续发布了。

sentences.en: But now the whole thing is officially out, which means that the fun part can start.
sentences.zh: 但现在整个榜单正式出炉了，这意味着有趣的部分可以开始了。

sentences.en: Picking that list apart.
sentences.zh: 对这份榜单进行剖析。

sentences.en: And that's what we're here today to do.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们今天要做的事情。

sentences.en: I've invited two of my colleagues to the show, Gilbert Cruz, who's our canon editor, and James Ponowozik, our chief TV critic.
sentences.zh: 我邀请了我的两位同事来到节目中，吉尔伯特·克鲁兹，我们的经典编辑，以及詹姆斯·波诺沃齐克，我们的首席电视评论员。

sentences.en: Both of them are TV fanatics, but neither of them picked the shows for this list, which means that they are free to debate it as much as they want.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都是电视狂热分子，但他们都没有参与这份榜单的评选，这意味着他们可以随心所欲地进行辩论。

sentences.en: It's Sunday, September 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月27日，星期日。

sentences.en: Jim, Gilbert, welcome to the Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，吉尔伯特，欢迎来到周日版《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: It is wonderful to have you both here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你们能来。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: It's great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Okay, I've set everything up in the intro, what the list is, the fact that neither of you can be blamed for it.
sentences.zh: 好的，我在开场白中已经做了铺垫，介绍了这份榜单是什么，以及你们两人都不用为此负责的事实。

sentences.en: Yeah, high five, Jim.
sentences.zh: 没错，击个掌，吉姆。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I think the thing that we should do is just dive right into the list itself.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该做的是直接深入榜单本身。

sentences.en: Give the people what they want.
sentences.zh: 给观众他们想要的。

sentences.en: I want to focus on the top 10 shows and what they tell us about what's happened in television over the last 25 years or so.
sentences.zh: 我想重点谈谈前10名的节目，以及它们向我们揭示了过去25年左右电视行业发生了什么。

sentences.en: I think we should start with numbers 6 to 10, and we'll save the top 5 for later in the show.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该从第6到第10名开始，前5名留到节目后面再说。

sentences.en: So, Gilbert, would you please give us the 10th to 6th best TV shows of the 21st century as voted on by our respondents?
sentences.zh: 那么，吉尔伯特，请你公布一下受访者投票选出的21世纪第10到第6佳电视节目好吗？

sentences.en: At number 10, we have Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 第10名是《亚特兰大》。

sentences.en: At number 9, Curb Your Enthusiasm.
sentences.zh: 第9名是《抑制热情》。

sentences.en: Number 8 is 30 Rock.
sentences.zh: 第8名是《我为喜剧狂》。

sentences.en: Number 7 is Veep.
sentences.zh: 第7名是《副总统》。

sentences.en: And number 6 is Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 第6名是《权力的游戏》。

sentences.en: The first thing that grabbed me about that rundown is just how many comedies are in there.
sentences.zh: 这份名单让我注意到的第一件事就是里面有多少喜剧。

sentences.en: There aren't actually a lot of comedies in the top 5.
sentences.zh: 其实前5名里并没有那么多喜剧。

sentences.en: And I don't mean to sound like Larry David here, but I do love complaining.
sentences.zh: 我不是想听起来像拉里·大卫，但我确实喜欢抱怨。

sentences.en: It's one of my hobbies.
sentences.zh: 这是我的爱好之一。

sentences.en: And so I do want to start with a complaint.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实想先从一个抱怨开始。

sentences.en: Why are the comedies in the lower half of the top 10?
sentences.zh: 为什么喜剧都在前10名的后半段？

sentences.en: Why aren't they in the top 5?
sentences.zh: 为什么它们没进前5名？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I have an opinion on this, and I know Jim has a very strong opinion on this.
sentences.zh: 对此我有看法，而且我知道吉姆对此也有非常强烈的看法。

sentences.en: And what I'm going to say is, yes, some of the titles, 10 through 6, are, quote, comedies.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，是的，第10到第6名中的一些作品确实是所谓的“喜剧”。

sentences.en: But I think something that this top 10 shows overall is that there's a way in which great shows always mix comedy and drama.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这份前10名榜单整体上显示出，伟大的节目总是将喜剧和戏剧融合在一起。

sentences.en: I think if...
sentences.zh: 我想如果……

sentences.en: I knew you were going to say that.
sentences.zh: 我就知道你会这么说。

sentences.en: I'm going to say it because it's right.
sentences.zh: 我会这么说是因为这是对的。

sentences.en: If you look at Atlanta, for example, the number 10 show, it is a, quote, comedy.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看第10名的节目《亚特兰大》，它是一部所谓的“喜剧”。

sentences.en: But some of the creepiest, most dramatic episodes I remember watching through that period came on Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 但我记得在那段时间里，我看过的一些最令人毛骨悚然、最具戏剧性的剧集都出自《亚特兰大》。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: For what?
sentences.zh: 为了什么？

sentences.en: I choose you.
sentences.zh: 我选中你了。

sentences.en: You're my sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 你是我的祭品。

sentences.en: Conversely, if you look at some of the episodes from the top 5 shows, they are full of laughs, even though they are drama.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果你看看前5名节目中的一些剧集，尽管它们是戏剧，但它们充满了笑声。

sentences.en: So I think sort of dividing it in that way, I think it's a little bit more complicated than that, with all due respect.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得以这种方式划分，恕我直言，情况要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Jim?
sentences.zh: 吉姆？

sentences.en: It actually surprised me that there was this much comedy in the top 10.
sentences.zh: 前10名里有这么多喜剧，这确实让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: You think of a lot of the most talked about television shows as being dramas from this period.
sentences.zh: 你会认为这一时期许多最受热议的电视节目都是戏剧。

sentences.en: On top of what you have that sort of ingrained bias, you know, you look at the Oscars, you know, dramas win Best Picture.
sentences.zh: 除了你那种根深蒂固的偏见之外，你知道，看看奥斯卡奖，戏剧总是赢得最佳影片。

sentences.en: Comedies, it's an honor just to be nominated.
sentences.zh: 对于喜剧来说，能获得提名就是一种荣誉。

sentences.en: It honestly was a bit of a surprising showing to me that this many comedies or dramedies or quasi-comedies or part of its comedy made as good a showing there.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这么多喜剧、悲喜剧或准喜剧能有如此好的表现，对我来说确实有点意外。

sentences.en: And to me, part of that is, I think, because people develop an affection for these kinds of shows.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，部分原因在于，我认为人们对这类节目产生了感情。

sentences.en: Um, and maybe that gives them a little more staying power.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许这赋予了它们更强的生命力。

sentences.en: I think one very big and interesting question within television of the past quarter century has been, you know, how funny does a comedy have to be?
sentences.zh: 我认为过去四分之一个世纪电视领域中一个非常重大且有趣的问题是，喜剧到底需要多好笑？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But, you know, do you really define comedy as just, you know, the highest number of jokes per minute?
sentences.zh: 但是，你真的把喜剧定义为每分钟笑话数量最多吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, but I mean, you can't deny that there is a particular joy to a show that is only trying to make you laugh.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，但我的意思是，你不能否认一部只试图让你发笑的节目有一种独特的乐趣。

sentences.en: Gilbert, around this project, you talk to a bunch of people who cast ballots for the best show.
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特，在这个项目期间，你和一群投票选出最佳节目的人交谈过。

sentences.en: I've been watching these interviews and so many of the respondents talk about being bowled over by just how many jokes are in a single episode of 30 Rock.
sentences.zh: 我一直在看这些采访，很多受访者都谈到被《我为喜剧狂》单集里的笑话数量之多所震撼。

sentences.en: Like, particularly the comedy people that you spoke with.
sentences.zh: 比如，特别是你采访的那些喜剧界人士。

sentences.en: I remember Brett Goldstein from Ted Lasso and Joel Kim Booster and Jesse Armstrong, who created Succession.
sentences.zh: 我记得《足球教练》的布雷特·戈德斯坦、乔尔·金·布斯特，还有创作了《继承之战》的杰西·阿姆斯特朗。

sentences.en: They are all so clearly enamored with 30 Rock.
sentences.zh: 他们显然都非常迷恋《我为喜剧狂》。

sentences.en: The amount of genius jokes per second is infuriating.
sentences.zh: 每秒钟天才笑话的数量简直令人抓狂。

sentences.en: I think the jokes per minute on that show are probably the highest of most comedies.
sentences.zh: 我认为该剧每分钟的笑话数量可能是大多数喜剧中最高的。

sentences.en: It's certainly higher than a lot of comedies that are airing right now.
sentences.zh: 它肯定比现在播出的许多喜剧都要高。

sentences.en: I almost find it painful to watch.
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得看它都有些痛苦。

sentences.en: It's so brilliant in its density of jokes.
sentences.zh: 它在笑话密度上太出色了。

sentences.en: Okay, I was going down some very enjoyable YouTube rabbit holes in prepping for this conversation,
sentences.zh: 好的，我在为这次谈话做准备时，掉进了一些非常有趣的YouTube兔子洞，

sentences.en: and I found, I think, what is the perfect example, which I'm going to play for you.
sentences.zh: 我找到了我认为最完美的例子，我要放给你听。

sentences.en: Tracy Jordan, played by Tracy Morgan, is talking to his doctor, Dr. Spachemin, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 由崔西·摩根饰演的崔西·乔丹正在和他的医生斯帕切明医生谈话，也就是

sentences.en: Dr. Spaceman.
sentences.zh: 斯帕斯曼医生。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Tracy, you are going to die.
sentences.zh: 崔西，你要死了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不！

sentences.en: When I tell you who I'm dating,
sentences.zh: 当我告诉你我在和谁约会时，

sentences.en: Squeaky Fromm, she is difficult.
sentences.zh: 斯奎基·弗洛姆，她很难搞。

sentences.en: Anywho, I have the results of your physical.
sentences.zh: 总之，我有你的体检结果了。

sentences.en: Tracy, you are going to die.
sentences.zh: 崔西，你要死了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不！

sentences.en: You have no reflexes, your blood tastes like root beer, and some of your bones appear to have vanished.
sentences.zh: 你没有反射神经，你的血尝起来像根汁汽水，而且你的一些骨头似乎消失了。

sentences.en: I, I, the reason I think this is the perfect example is that I think there's six jokes in ten seconds.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我认为这是完美例子的原因是，我觉得十秒钟里有六个笑话。

sentences.en: Like, every single thing that was said minus one word is a joke.
sentences.zh: 就像除了一个词以外，说的每一件事都是一个笑话。

sentences.en: I didn't understand the phrase joke density, which a lot of people used in reference to this show,
sentences.zh: 我以前不理解“笑话密度”这个词，很多人在提到这部剧时都用过它，

sentences.en: until I watched 30 Rock.
sentences.zh: 直到我看了《我为喜剧狂》。

sentences.en: The idea that every joke maybe has three punchlines within it.
sentences.zh: 那种每个笑话里可能包含三个包袱的想法。

sentences.en: Lemon, you look terrible, and I once watched you eat oysters while you had a cold.
sentences.zh: 莱蒙，你看起来糟透了，我曾经见过你在感冒的时候吃牡蛎。

sentences.en: We had him, Jack, and we lost him.
sentences.zh: 我们本来抓到他了，杰克，但我们把他弄丢了。

sentences.en: So Kenneth and I had to spend the rest of the afternoon trying to think like Tracy.
sentences.zh: 所以肯尼斯和我不得不花一下午的时间试着像崔西那样思考。

sentences.en: I ended up eating a swordfish dinner at a strip club, and Kenneth grabbed a cop's gun and shot a blimp.
sentences.zh: 我最后在脱衣舞俱乐部吃了顿剑鱼晚餐，而肯尼斯抢了一名警察的枪并射击了一艘飞艇。

sentences.en: Well, tomorrow's another day.
sentences.zh: 好吧，明天又是新的一天。

sentences.en: And, you know, for me, that's a, that's a thing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，对我来说，那是一回事。

sentences.en: I'm going to offend some of our listeners, but it turns me off about a show like Family Guy, for instance.
sentences.zh: 我会冒犯一些听众，但这让我对《恶搞之家》这样的节目感到反感。

sentences.en: You know, I think that there is a, there is a line where, you know, if you are just the unending joke machine, you end up with Family Guy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为有一条界线，如果你只是一个永无止境的笑话机器，你最终就会变成《恶搞之家》。

sentences.en: But, you know, 30 Rock, I think, also had a take.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，《我为喜剧狂》我觉得也很有自己的特色。

sentences.en: Okay, I want to talk about a show that I personally would have put in my top five,

sentences.en: Okay, so I think Curb Your Enthusiasm gets at one of these questions of what is 21st century TV?
sentences.zh: 好的，我认为《抑制热情》触及了“什么是21世纪电视”的问题之一。

sentences.en: What was great in 21st century TV?
sentences.zh: 21世纪的电视里什么才是伟大的？

sentences.en: Because Curb Your Enthusiasm comes, of course, from Larry David.
sentences.zh: 因为《抑制热情》当然是出自拉里·大卫之手。

sentences.en: He created Seinfeld with Jerry Seinfeld.
sentences.zh: 他和杰瑞·宋飞一起创作了《宋飞正传》。

sentences.en: A lot of the same themes, a lot of the same sort of, you know, attention to faux pas and gripes and personal minutiae.
sentences.zh: 有很多相同的主题，很多对社交失礼、抱怨和个人琐事的关注。

sentences.en: But Curb Your Enthusiasm, the sort of freedom and range of expression that he got from doing this show for HBO,
sentences.zh: 但《抑制热情》那种他在HBO做这部剧所获得的自由和表达范围，

sentences.en: allowed him to create this pure, raw, uncut version of it that I think in many ways, maybe not by itself,
sentences.zh: 让他能够创造出这种纯粹、原始、未删减的版本，我认为在很多方面，也许不仅仅是它自己，

sentences.en: you can also, you know, throw in shows like The British Office here and so on.
sentences.zh: 你也可以把像英版《办公室》之类的剧也加进来。

sentences.en: It kind of defined this genre of cringe comedy, for lack of a better word, that you see coming up in show after show after show on the larger list here.

sentences.en: I'm Julia Louis-Dreyfus, and guess what?
sentences.zh: 我是朱莉娅·路易斯-德瑞弗斯，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Imagine that.

sentences.en: The idea of nothing, to a certain extent, is taken to the 10th power or 100th power on Curb.

sentences.en: These small conflicts that are usually nothing are exaggerated and put under a microscope and made large.

sentences.en: That idea existed on Seinfeld, of course.

sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得每次看这部剧，我都能看到它在工艺、结构和艺术性上新的层面。

sentences.en: Gilbert?
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特？

sentences.en: I've watched Mad Men all the way through several times as well.
sentences.zh: 《广告狂人》我也完整看过好几遍了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And it is just, it's wonderful to look at.
sentences.zh: 而且它就是，看起来太棒了。

sentences.en: Everyone looks so cool and stylish, and there's something about the 60s and people smoking and drinking, and there's a little fantasy fulfillment there.
sentences.zh: 每个人看起来都那么酷、那么时髦，而且60年代那种人们抽烟喝酒的氛围，带有一种小小的幻想满足感。

sentences.en: But there is also a way in which this show is just as psychologically perceptive as any other show I've seen on TV.
sentences.zh: 但这部剧在心理洞察力上也和我在电视上看到的任何其他剧一样深刻。

sentences.en: And I think it does have to do with the underlying conceit that Jim talked about.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实与吉姆提到的潜在构思有关。

sentences.en: It is about advertising.
sentences.zh: 它是关于广告的。

sentences.en: It is about, in a way, lying to people in order to sell a product.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，它是关于为了推销产品而对人们撒谎。

sentences.en: It's also about people lying to themselves and each other about who they are, who we are.
sentences.zh: 它也是关于人们对自己、对彼此撒谎，掩盖他们是谁，我们是谁。

sentences.en: It's very deep, amazingly performed, very funny, very funny show.
sentences.zh: 这是一部非常深刻、表演令人惊叹、非常有趣的剧。

sentences.en: And I just love it so much.
sentences.zh: 我真的太爱它了。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Coleman Domingo, and I voted for the New York Times Best TV Shows of the 21st Century.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是科尔曼·多明戈，我为《纽约时报》21世纪最佳电视剧榜单投了票。

sentences.en: Well, Mad Men ushered in the golden age of television.
sentences.zh: 嗯，《广告狂人》开启了电视的黄金时代。

sentences.en: It really did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was groundbreaking for AMC, and it really gave us characters, like essential characters that you can, you sort of believed in, but then you were conflicted by.
sentences.zh: 这对AMC来说是开创性的，它确实给了我们一些角色，比如那些你觉得可以信任，但随后又让你感到矛盾的关键角色。

sentences.en: You were looking at our culture, you were looking at how women are treated in our culture, and how the things that they had to do.
sentences.zh: 你在审视我们的文化，审视女性在我们的文化中是如何被对待的，以及她们不得不做的事情。

sentences.en: The character Peggy is one of my favorite characters, to watch her start from where she was starting, and then watch her evolve, and find her voice.
sentences.zh: 佩吉这个角色是我最喜欢的角色之一，看着她从起点开始，然后看着她进化，找到自己的声音。

sentences.en: And also Don Draper, to see, like, you know, all his pitfalls, and look at, it's deconstructing the myth and the American dream of the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 还有唐·德雷珀，去看看，你知道，他所有的陷阱，看看，它是在解构神话和20世纪50年代的美国梦。

sentences.en: Okay, getting closer to the top of the list here.
sentences.zh: 好了，离榜单前列越来越近了。

sentences.en: Gilbert, what's number two?
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特，第二名是什么？

sentences.en: The Wire.
sentences.zh: 《火线》。

sentences.en: This feels like the ultimate, we don't really have time to dig into this show, kind of show, but let's do what we can.
sentences.zh: 感觉这部剧是终极之作，我们真的没时间深入探讨它，但我们尽力而为吧。

sentences.en: Hey, yo, lesson here, bae.
sentences.zh: 嘿，听着，宝贝，给你上一课。

sentences.en: You come at the king, you best not miss.
sentences.zh: 你要是想挑战国王，最好别失手。

sentences.en: Um, I should start off saying that I was actually really stunned to see that The Wire did not end up as number one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我得先说，我真的很惊讶《火线》竟然没有排在第一名。

sentences.en: Same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: That's, it's not just because I think it's one of the most amazing achievements that's been accomplished on TV, or, you know, maybe any popular art form,
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为我认为它是电视史上，或者说，任何流行艺术形式中最令人惊叹的成就之一，

sentences.en: in terms of just telling this all-encompassing story of the dysfunction of cities and of systeMs.
sentences.zh: 就仅仅是讲述这个关于城市和系统功能失调的包罗万象的故事而言。

sentences.en: And it was so broad and sprawling and yet never felt like it was wasting your time or losing focus.
sentences.zh: 它如此宏大、广阔，却从不让人觉得在浪费时间或失去焦点。

sentences.en: I'm D.B.
sentences.zh: 我是D.B.

sentences.en: Weiss, and I voted for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 韦斯，我为《纽约时报》投了票。

sentences.en: I'm David Benioff, and I voted for the New York Times Best TV Shows of the 21st Century.
sentences.zh: 我是大卫·贝尼奥夫，我为《纽约时报》21世纪最佳电视剧榜单投了票。

sentences.en: I think the fourth season of The Wire is the greatest season of television, um, that I've seen.
sentences.zh: 我认为《火线》的第四季是我看过的最伟大的电视季。

sentences.en: I just think it's, uh, kind of like a novel from beginning to end.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得它，呃，从头到尾就像一部小说。

sentences.en: The Wire asks for a lot of you, it demands a lot of you, and it deserves that.
sentences.zh: 《火线》对你要求很高，它对你索求很多，而且它值得这样做。

sentences.en: That season for me is just, kind of shows what television is capable of, what a season of television is capable of, um, at its highest powers.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那一季只是，展示了电视的能力，一个电视季的能力，嗯，在它最强大的时候。

sentences.en: Like, reading War and Peace isn't easy and takes a lot of your time and a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 就像读《战争与和平》并不容易，需要花费你大量的时间和精力。

sentences.en: And ultimately, when you finish reading War and Peace, you're damn glad you finished reading War and Peace.
sentences.zh: 最终，当你读完《战争与和平》时，你会非常庆幸自己读完了它。

sentences.en: And I kind of felt the same way about The Wire, which, on the upside, I think takes less time than reading War and Peace.
sentences.zh: 我对《火线》也有同样的感觉，而且往好处想，我觉得它比读《战争与和平》花的时间少。

sentences.en: First of all, it's just got tremendously rich, flawed characters.
sentences.zh: 首先，它拥有极其丰富、有缺陷的角色。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Um, you know, on, very rarely for TV, on one side of the law as much as on the other.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，在电视上非常罕见，法律的一边和另一边一样多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Uh, you know, the, the, the criminals in this show are not just perps.
sentences.zh: 呃，你知道，剧中的罪犯不仅仅是罪犯。

sentences.en: They are people with ideas and motivations and backstories.
sentences.zh: 他们是有想法、有动机、有背景故事的人。

sentences.en: I win.
sentences.zh: 我赢了。

sentences.en: If you catch the other dude's king and trap it, then you win.
sentences.zh: 如果你抓住了对方的国王并困住它，你就赢了。

sentences.en: All right, but if I make it to the end, I'm top dog.
sentences.zh: 好吧，但如果我走到最后，我就是老大。

sentences.en: Nah, yo, it ain't like that.
sentences.zh: 不，伙计，不是那样的。

sentences.en: Look, pawns, man, in the game, they get capped quick.
sentences.zh: 听着，棋子，伙计，在游戏中，它们很快就会被干掉。

sentences.en: They be out the game early.
sentences.zh: 它们很早就出局了。

sentences.en: Unless they some smart-ass pawns.
sentences.zh: 除非它们是聪明的棋子。

sentences.en: The way that the show digs into the systems of America at all levels is what makes it so unique and so special.
sentences.zh: 这部剧深入挖掘美国各级系统的方式，使其如此独特和特别。

sentences.en: People have used the word novelistic to refer to the show.
sentences.zh: 人们用“小说化”这个词来形容这部剧。

sentences.en: And I think some people use it because books are fancier than TV.
sentences.zh: 我想有些人用它是因为书比电视更高级。

sentences.en: And so to call something novelistic means that you're giving it a level of appreciation that TV doesn't usually get.
sentences.zh: 所以称某物为小说化意味着你给予了它电视通常得不到的赞赏。

sentences.en: But I think it is appropriate in the way in which, unlike almost any other TV show, it, it sort of moves between all these different levels.
sentences.zh: 但我认为它是恰当的，因为它几乎不像其他任何电视剧，它在所有这些不同的层面之间穿梭。

sentences.en: I'm Brett Goldstein, and I voted for the best TV shows of the 21st century for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是布雷特·戈德斯坦，我为《纽约时报》21世纪最佳电视剧榜单投了票。

sentences.en: I'm not joking when I say this.
sentences.zh: 我这么说不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: The Wire is how I understand the world.
sentences.zh: 《火线》是我理解世界的方式。

sentences.en: I truly think it taught me how the world works.
sentences.zh: 我真心认为它教会了我世界是如何运作的。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is how people work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它教会了我人是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Not just the show shows you how the police work, how the government works, how the press works, how the drug dealers work, how the diva doors work.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是这部剧向你展示了警察如何工作、政府如何工作、媒体如何工作、毒贩如何工作、码头工人如何工作。

sentences.en: It shows you all of that.
sentences.zh: 它向你展示了所有这些。

sentences.en: It shows you all the elements that make up a city.
sentences.zh: 它向你展示了构成城市的所有要素。

sentences.en: But the way that it expresses how hard it is to achieve anything good is so clear.
sentences.zh: 但它表达实现任何好事有多么困难的方式是如此清晰。

sentences.en: It really did change how I saw the world and how people work and how 90% of people are just trying to protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 它确实改变了我看待世界的方式，看待人如何运作的方式，以及90%的人只是在试图保护自己的方式。

sentences.en: And that's why it makes it impossible to achieve anything.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它让人不可能实现任何目标。

sentences.en: And any small incremental change for good is a miracle.
sentences.zh: 任何微小的、渐进的向善改变都是一个奇迹。

sentences.en: I feel like this show, more than any other show I've seen, shines a very entertaining, but very serious and very perceptive light, unlike a dark corner of the American experiment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这部剧，比我见过的任何其他剧都更能照亮美国实验的一个黑暗角落，既有趣又非常严肃且富有洞察力。

sentences.en: The job will not save you, Jimmy.
sentences.zh: 工作救不了你，吉米。

sentences.en: It won't make you whole.
sentences.zh: 它不会让你完整。

sentences.en: It won't fill your ass up.
sentences.zh: 它填不满你的空虚。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: A good case.
sentences.zh: 一个好的案件。

sentences.en: Ends.
sentences.zh: 结束了。

sentences.en: They all end.
sentences.zh: 它们都会结束。

sentences.en: The handcuffs go click and it's over.
sentences.zh: 手铐咔哒一声，一切就结束了。

sentences.en: And the next morning, it's just you in your room with yourself.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，房间里就只剩下你自己了。

sentences.en: Until the next case.
sentences.zh: 直到下一个案件。

sentences.en: Boy, you need something outside of this here.
sentences.zh: 伙计，你需要这之外的东西。

sentences.en: Okay, I feel a little bit like we're saying, that's enough about Hamlet, let's move on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我感觉我们有点像在说，关于《哈姆雷特》说得够多了，我们继续吧。

sentences.en: But we do have to talk about number one on this list, which is Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实必须谈谈榜单上的第一名，也就是吉尔伯特。

sentences.en: Breaking Bad!
sentences.zh: 《绝命毒师》！

sentences.en: Who are you talking to right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在是在跟谁说话？

sentences.en: Who is it you think you see?
sentences.zh: 你以为你看到的是谁？

sentences.en: What makes this the best show?
sentences.zh: 是什么让它成为最好的剧？

sentences.en: And I'm asking you to embody the best case.
sentences.zh: 我要求你给出最好的理由。

sentences.en: I understand you may not agree, but make the case.
sentences.zh: 我明白你可能不同意，但请给出你的理由。

sentences.en: Wow, do we have two non-agreers?
sentences.zh: 哇，我们有两个不同意的人吗？

sentences.en: On the panel, just to check.
sentences.zh: 在小组里，只是确认一下。

sentences.en: I mean, it's an incredible show.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一部不可思议的剧。

sentences.en: I'm just, you know, it's not the wire.
sentences.zh: 我只是，你知道，它不是《火线》。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a show that I probably would have put in my top five or top ten.
sentences.zh: 是的，这可能是我会放进前五或前十的剧。

sentences.en: I am not in danger, Skyler.
sentences.zh: 我没有危险，斯凯勒。

sentences.en: I am the danger.
sentences.zh: 我就是危险。

sentences.en: A guy opens his door and gets shot and you think that of me?
sentences.zh: 一个人打开门被枪杀，你就那样看我？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I am the one who knocks.
sentences.zh: 我才是那个敲门的人。

sentences.en: So Breaking Bad, a show created by Vince Gilligan, is essentially the story of Walter White, who, when we start the series, is a chemistry teacher.
sentences.zh: 所以《绝命毒师》，一部由文斯·吉里根创作的剧，本质上是沃尔特·怀特的故事，当我们开始这个系列时，他是一名化学老师。

sentences.en: He finds out that he has cancer, doesn't have that much longer to live, and he decides to get into the meth business.
sentences.zh: 他发现自己得了癌症，没剩下多少时间了，于是他决定进入冰毒行业。

sentences.en: Because he knows chemistry so well, he's going to produce the finest meth that has ever been produced, get a bunch of money, leave it for his family,
sentences.zh: 因为他非常精通化学，他要生产出有史以来最纯的冰毒，赚一大笔钱，留给他的家人，

sentences.en: and along the way, he turns into, essentially, a kingpin in Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，他本质上变成了阿尔伯克基的一个大毒枭。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, say my name.
sentences.zh: 现在，说出我的名字。

sentences.en: Heisenberg.
sentences.zh: 海森堡。

sentences.en: Goddamn right.
sentences.zh: 该死的没错。

sentences.en: It is a crime show.
sentences.zh: 这是一部犯罪剧。

sentences.en: People love crime shows.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢犯罪剧。

sentences.en: It has an amazing cast, you know, starring with Bryan Cranston.
sentences.zh: 它有一个令人惊叹的演员阵容，你知道，由布莱恩·科兰斯顿领衔主演。

sentences.en: It has amazing villains, including Giancarlo Esposito as Gus Fring.
sentences.zh: 它有令人惊叹的反派，包括吉安卡罗·埃斯波西托饰演的古斯·弗林。

sentences.en: It is tense.
sentences.zh: 它很紧张。

sentences.en: It is violent.
sentences.zh: 它很暴力。

sentences.en: It arrived at a perfect moment for the binge age.
sentences.zh: 它出现在了适合刷剧时代的完美时刻。

sentences.en: This show is made to be binged.
sentences.zh: 这部剧就是为了刷剧而制作的。

sentences.en: It has incredible cliffhangers.
sentences.zh: 它有令人难以置信的悬念。

sentences.en: It has incredible energy and forward motion.
sentences.zh: 它有令人难以置信的能量和前进动力。

sentences.en: Okay, can I just say, I had watched what I thought was almost all of Breaking Bad,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我可以直说吗，我看了我以为几乎所有的《绝命毒师》，

sentences.en: and then stopped watching it because it was too intense.
sentences.zh: 然后停止观看，因为它太紧张了。

sentences.en: And so, in preparation for this, I fired it back up because I was like, I have to see the end.
sentences.zh: 所以，为了准备这次讨论，我又重新看了起来，因为我想，我必须看到结局。

sentences.en: Turns out, I was not as close to the end as I thought.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，我离结局并没有我想象的那么近。

sentences.en: So then I had to binge basically all of the last season of Breaking Bad, and can I just say, it's not an enjoyable experience.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不一口气刷完了《绝命毒师》的最后一季，我可以直说吗，这不是一种愉快的体验。

sentences.en: I hear you, that there's cliffhangers, so you just want to keep eating it up, but it does something to you.
sentences.zh: 我听到了，因为有悬念，所以你只想一直看下去，但它会对你产生影响。

sentences.en: It messes with your head.
sentences.zh: 它会扰乱你的心智。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people like that, just to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人喜欢那样，说明白点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I also think that that kind of points up something that was really interesting in the experience of TV and how we watched TV in the 21st century,
sentences.zh: 是的，我也认为这指出了21世纪电视体验和我们观看电视方式中非常有趣的一点，

sentences.en: which is, okay, a lot of people watched Breaking Bad slowly, the old-fashioned TV way.
sentences.zh: 那就是，好吧，很多人是慢慢地看《绝命毒师》的，用老式电视的方式。

sentences.en: They watched one episode a week, and then another one the next week, and then they waited a year or whatever, and they watched the next season, right?
sentences.zh: 他们一周看一集，然后下周看下一集，然后等一年或者什么的，再看下一季，对吧？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And some people did what you did, and, you know, enjoyed it better than you did, maybe, but, you know, really plowed through this.
sentences.zh: 有些人做了你做的事，而且，你知道，可能比你享受得更好，但，你知道，确实是一口气看完的。

sentences.en: Now, what's the difference between those?
sentences.zh: 那么，这两者之间有什么区别？

sentences.en: Well, as Gilbert was saying, what Breaking Bad is really rooted in is a moral question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如吉尔伯特所说，《绝命毒师》真正扎根于一个道德问题。

sentences.en: And I think the interesting question that Gilligan raises in the show is, did Walter White's experience turn him from a good person to a bad person?
sentences.zh: 我认为吉里根在剧中提出的有趣问题是，沃尔特·怀特的经历是否让他从一个好人变成了一个坏人？

sentences.en: Or was there this potentially bad person all the time in him that had the opportunity to get out because of his circumstances?
sentences.zh: 还是说他内心一直潜伏着一个潜在的坏人，只是因为环境原因才有机会释放出来？

sentences.en: And I honestly think that the way you see that might well depend on, you know, how you watched the show.
sentences.zh: 我真心认为你如何看待这一点，很可能取决于，你知道，你是如何观看这部剧的。

sentences.en: If you watch it slowly over time, it can seem more like it's a good person turning into a bad person.
sentences.zh: 如果你随着时间慢慢看，它看起来更像是一个好人变成了一个坏人。

sentences.en: If you binge it, you may be more likely to see that, no, this is actually the story of somebody who, you know, Heisenberg was in him all along.
sentences.zh: 如果你刷剧，你可能更有可能看到，不，这实际上是一个人的故事，你知道，海森堡一直都在他体内。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And was just waiting to bust out.
sentences.zh: 只是在等待爆发。

sentences.en: Heisenberg being his nom de guerre, his...
sentences.zh: 海森堡是他的化名，他的...

sentences.en: His nom de meth.
sentences.zh: 他的“制毒化名”。

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: And I'm not sure anyone, unless they have gone through it, can truly understand how that loss is.

sentences.en: It was beautifully acted, sensitive, nuanced, almost like religious exploration of redemption

sentences.en: and grace and forgiveness that maybe, for those reasons, never generated that much of an audience.

sentences.en: But, you know, I just think was a gorgeous character portrait that didn't get enough attention then and now.

sentences.en: But if you can seek it out on streaming, I highly recommend you add to your liSt.
